Census-Kent County

Preserved Primary Document • census04.htm

The categories provided in this census were: "Free white persons including heads of families" with a breakdown by age and sex; "All other free persons except Indians" "Slaves" The following are names extracted from the Federal Census Rolls. Some are known members of the mixed race community: others are included because they have similar names to the Kent County community and may or may not have been related. What is very interesting about this census is the number of families, known to be still living in the area, who are not included.
